note: Grand Mesa NF (Grand Valley RD) campground at ~10,130 ft on the south shore of Big Creek Reservoir; the loop runs along the shore behind a fringe of conifers and most sites are shady. Hand-pump water. Reached by a long gravel road: FR 121 from CO-65 north of Cedaredge, or CR 58/59 then FR 521 from Collbran. Reservoir is drawn down in summer and recent reviews call the grounds run-down but operating. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 10165145: confirmed 33-ft max spur, vault toilets, potable water, FCFS only with Scan and Pay, $18 (additional vehicle $9). Added season 06-26..09-22. No site count published (rec.gov catalog has a single placeholder site). Note cleaned.

Lakeview (stored) - re-audit lead, waterfront not changed: the stored evidence says the loops sit 150-250 m back across open meadow, but on imagery (reservoir full) the camping loop on the west side of the road runs along the reservoir's south shore, its spurs ~25-40 m from the full-pool waterline behind a fringe of conifers, and the loop's west end opens onto meadow running ~50-60 m to the shore. The meadow by the pin with tracks to the shore looks like day use. Worth a fresh look in both directions.

Pin 39.07774,-107.88295 equals the FS/rec.gov facility point, which is at the turn-off on the road, ~200-400 m ESE of the camping loop (centre ~39.0790,-107.8855). Not off by more than ~400 m, but a pin on the loop would be better. rec.gov has no per-site coordinates.
